reviews.text: We have built not one …. But TWO pools with Tanner and Tyler. They are truly the best. When we bought a new house it was a no brainer that we would use them to build our new pool. They are so easy to communicate with, very easy to work with, happy to incorporate any new ideas or changes you have along the way, and always stay on schedule! If anything changes they are always quick to let you know. Construction is never fun but they have made it a pleasant experience both times we have worked with them. Both our old yard and our new yard have gotten so many compliments and I’m always thrilled to share with people that we use Dolce Pools. If you’re ever considering a pool build/back yard renovation- these are your guys!
reviews.author: Christy Cummins Gongora

reviews.text:
We simply can't recommend Dolce Pools enough. Tanner, Tyler and the crew took this crazy idea we had to drop a pool in our oddly shaped backyard and made it into a reality.

We had gotten another quote from someone else before and SO glad we decided to get a second opinion because Tanner shot straight with us, letting us know what we couldn't do but more importantly what we could.

Communication was consistent throughout the entire process, their customer service is -- speaking from someone who cut their teeth working in the mall as a teenager and young adult -- some of the best I've ever seen.

As you can see from the photo, its already getting plenty of use (never mind the dirt, I am reseeding this week!) and love.

I promise promise promise you if you are in the market of getting a pool put into your backyard, you cannot do better the Dolce Pools.
reviews.author: Sergio Hernandez

reviews.text: Tyler, Tanner and the Dolce team did an amazing job with our pool and outdoor kitchen. Fantastic company - highly recommend.
reviews.author: Brian Parker

reviews.text: Dolce Pools did a great job for our family.   Tyler and his team took the time to discuss, review, and revise several layouts for what we wanted.  They were able to accommodate the wider coping for the Lueders limestone, among other requests.  He is the easiest to work with, knowledgeable about the details, as well as the big picture,  and is effective in getting things done.    I am also a repeat customer, he designed and installed our last pool 15 years ago in our first house.
reviews.author: Brian McFarlane

reviews.text:
We are very happy with the finished product of pool, spa and gazebo from Dolce Pools. Tyler and his crew met and exceeded our expectations on quality of finished product, timelines, and customer service. Here are some reasons why:
1. Design process was clear and simple with multiple visits to plan within our budget
2. No hard sell, upsell, or marketing push. Tyler waited on us to shop around and decide when and how we wanted to build
3. Timelines were clear and accountable. They met all of the pool build timelines
4. Clear and timely communication. They were careful when they worked and came back for any required touchups and communicated throughout the process
5. The finished product not only met our expectations, but they remained open to conversations about “how-to” on pool maintenance and repairs as needed. They even stopped by and repaired some damage done by lawnmowing!
We are very pleased to support this local family owned business and highly recommend Dolce Pools!
reviews.author: Shlomit Eema

reviews.text:
My wife and I selected Tyler Neufeldt of Dolce Pools to build our new pool, and we couldn't be happier with our choice.

We considered several other builders, and got a quote from one other builder.  We based our decision to go with Dolce on both value and rapport.  We feel that we've gotten the best features and quality while working with someone who is responsive and trustworthy.

During the Sales phase, Tyler met with us to quote us the pool of our dreams.  His extensive library of completed project pictures gave us plenty to think about.  He then went to work on his laptop while on site.  The result was a 3D model that helped us visualize the project in our backyard.  The process is very collaborative, as we made selections and changes along the way.  That quickly resulted in a quotation that he emailed to us.

Unfortunately, the financing that we were trying to put into place didn't work out, and we had to put the project on hold for a year.  So this was the first big test:  When the timing was right we called to put the project in motion, and Tyler was still there, ready to work with us.
We then worked with him to scale down the project.  The pool of our dreams was more expensive than our budget, so we trimmed back.

Again, Tyler was happy to work with us in this process, and didn't get turned off because the project ended up being half of the original size.  If you're curious, we cut out an arbor and some beautiful fire bowls that were really distinctive.

We went all the way through the permit process, only to suffer a financial setback and have to put the project on hold again.  We were finally able to give the green light to Tyler in December, and his crew was out digging the hole a few days later.

From start to finish, the project took 8 weeks from digging to having the pool full of water.  It was right around the timeframe that he had quoted, and was right on given a few weather setbacks and no work going on during the Christmas break.

One of the first things you learn: Tyler communicates.  If a crew is going to be onsite, I got a text before it happened.  I always knew what the next step was.  If there was a delay, I understood why.

Tyler was personally involved every step of the way.  He's been in the industry for a long time and works with contractors that he has a long relationship with.  This is a big win because he knows the quality of work he will get, and they are responsive to his keen eye for detail.  Here's a small example:  Tyler likes the tile around the skimmers to be placed in a certain way so that the edge of the tile is just right.  When the tile crew didn't get it right the first time, he had only to mention it to them and they fixed it to his way.  Bear in mind – I hadn't noticed the tile issue or complained.  He just has an eye  for detail and holds the contractors to his standard.

We're working on the last few items – the punch list – as I write this review.  The pool is full, the pump is running.  Every morning I text the test strip results to Tyler and he texts back with what chemicals to add and next steps to take.  Every punch list item I've brought up, the answer is "we'll take care of that".

The big question you take on as you do a construction project is … can I trust the contractor?   If you don't choose well, the result could be a partially completed hole in your backyard, all your money gone, and no way forward.  I appreciate the reviews done by others that I could rely on when looking for a builder.

We are very pleased to be one of those customers who would be happy to show off their pool, take a reference phone call, and give a full recommendation for Tyler and Dolce Pools.
reviews.author: Dale Warner

reviews.text: Extremely happy with the quality of work and support from Dolce! Tanner and Tyler not only walked us through every phase of the building process, but continue to answer questions and support us nearly a year after completion. The guys are top notch and I would recommend them to anyone interested in not just a pool, but a backyard oasis.
reviews.author: Spencer Riley

reviews.text: Dolce built our pool about 5 years ago and did a great job.  Tyler is very easy to work with and the process went smoothly.  We recently had a crack that needed repair, which Tyler fixed at his cost.  In addition, he spent extra money above what the crack fix required in order to make the repair look good.
reviews.author: Aaron Shields
